attempts.text:
Tauseef Deshpande
$9 Tauseef4550@zgmail.com| HB +9177982 69770| Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Procurement & Contract Management professional with 8+ years’ experience in real estate and facilities
management. Skilled in vendor negotiations, contract administration, and cost optimization, with a
background in civil engineering and an MBA in Operations. Proven ability to manage multi-crore contracts,
reduce procurement costs, and ensure 100% audit compliance while building strong supplier partnerships.

Core Competencies

* RFQ/RFP/PR Management & BOQ Analysis

* Vendor Evaluation, Negotiation & Contract Finalization

* Contract Drafting & Compliance

* Processing and monitoring billing of vendors

© Due diligence and timely contracts renewal

* Budgeting & Cost Estimation

* Cross-functional Collaboration (Engineering, Finance, Legal)

* Stakeholder & Client Management

* Ensures Accountability, Persuades, Resourcefulness, Decision Quality
* Situational Adaptability, Manages Complexity, Being Resilient

Professional Experience

Eco-First Subsidiary of TATA Enterprises | Manager — Procurement & Contracts | May 2026 —
Till date.

* Managed the end-to-end lifecycle of contracts, including preparation, evaluation, issuance of work
orders, and closure, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and project requirements.

« Reviewed vendor proposals and technical specifications, conducted tendering processes, and finalized
contracts based on commercial terms, deliverables, timelines, and budget considerations.

« Negotiated pricing, terms, and conditions with vendors to achieve cost efficiency and optimal value for
the organization

« Maintained comprehensive records of all issued work orders, contract documents, and procurement
activities, ensuring traceability and audit readiness.

« Monitored contract performance, deliverables, and timelines to ensure adherence to agreed terms and
project milestones.

* Coordinated with cross-functional stakeholders including Project Management, Finance, and Billing
teams for vendor onboarding, invoice verification, and timely payment processing.

CBRE South Asia Pvt Ltd | Assistant Manager — Procurement & Contracts | Jul 2022 —Jan
2026

« Managed end-to-end procurement lifecycle (RFQ, bid evaluation, vendor negotiation, PO issuance).

« Negotiated contracts worth Rs.10 + Cr annually, achieving Approx. 11.5% cost savings through strategic
sourcing.

« Reduced PR-PO cycle time by 20%, aligning with SOPs and TAT requirements.

* Conducted due diligence and renewed 100% contracts on time to avoid service disruptions.

* Coordinated with stakeholders and vendors to ensure audit success (5-Star rating, 2022-23).

« Implemented contract schedules aligned with project timelines, ensuring on-time project delivery.



JLL Property Management | Civil & Fit-Out Engineer | January 2021 —June 2022

* Supervised civil fit-out work ensuring compliance with fit-out manuals and safety norms.

« Coordinated with contractors, vendors, and consultants for timely execution of projects.

* Conducted site inspections and closed 95% snag list items within SLA timelines.

« Oversaw structural maintenance, facade, plumbing, and civil repair activities with minimal downtime.
« Implemented effective facade and structural leakage treatment strategies, eliminating 98% of 239
leakage cases and enhancing the property's structural integrity

« Assisted in cost estimation, vendor selection, and procurement of materials.

Dr. Ulhas Patil Foundation & Trust | Civil Engineer | November 2019 — December 2021

« Managed civil construction and maintenance projects for hospital & college facilities.

« Prepared BOQs, BBS, Measurement, contractor bill certification ensuring accuracy and zero material
wastage.

« Managing inventory, Material Supplies and vendor performance.

« Supervised site labor, subcontractors, and safety compliance across multiple projects.

« Successfully delivered end-to-end RCC construction works (slabs, beams, columns) within timelines.

Aakar Engineers & Contractors | Civil Engineer | June 2017 — October 2019

« Interpreting various technical drawings, including plan, section elevation, dimension and other critical
details

« Initial Project planning, Cost estimation and scheduling.

* Demonstrate day to day site management expertise, encompassing the supervision and monitoring of
site labor and sub-contractor activity.

* Prepare comprehensive BBS and accurately quantify the steel and concrete for slab, beams and other
RCC member to minimize the material wastage.

Education

MBA - Operations Management, NMIMS University, Mumbai (2022-2024) - [62%]
BE - Civil Engineering, North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon (2014-2017) - [73%]
Diploma = Civil Engineering, MSBTE, Mumbai (2011-2014) - [75%]

$5C - Maharashtra State Board of Education (2010-2011) - [85.27%]

Computer Proficiency & Software's

*SAPS/4 HANA «Farvision «Tally «*MS-CIT «AutoCad2D_ « English Typing

Certifications & Awards

« Certified: Avoiding Conflict of Interest, Anti-Bribery, Financial Integrity & Fraud Prevention, Raising
Concerns, Dignity & Respect in Workplace

« Service Excellence Award - CBRE (2024, Process Value Creation)

« First Aid Trainer Certification (2024) | Train-the-Trainer (2023)

* National & State Level Awards: Science Exhibition, Technical Symposium, Karate Championship

« Anti bribery & anti-corruption (ABAC) policy, Anti Money Laundering (AML), Gift & Hospitality (G&H),
Prevention of sexual harassment (POSH)

Languages

English | Hindi | Marathi | Urdu
